hybrid_access.description: New catalogs default to granting IAMAllowedPrincipals on create_database_default_permissions / create_table_default_permissions. Retaining them keeps resources IAM-governed until explicitly enrolled in LF.
aws_lakeformation_resource hybrid_access_enabled lets a registered location serve both IAM and LF principals - intended for migration windows only.
Under hybrid mode a principal gets access if EITHER IAM policy OR LF grant allows it - the union is evaluated, so a permissive IAM policy defeats LF filters.
hybrid_access.signal: IAM policies containing lakeformation:/glue: actions alongside LF grants
